requirements.title: BTEST arguments are an integer and a valid bit position
requirements.definition: The I argument to BTEST shall be of type integer; POS shall be of type integer, nonnegative, and less than BIT_SIZE(I).
requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Future fixtures initialize scalar result variables or arrays to non-default, opposite, or otherwise load-bearing sentinels before calling the intrinsic and assert only exact logical, integer, kind, scalar-rank, POS-boundary, or bit-sequence properties fixed by 16.9 and its 16.3/16.3.2 dependencies. POS controls include both the lower boundary 0 and the upper valid boundary BIT_SIZE(I)-1.

S16.9.50-001 intrinsics_16_9_e fixture: BTEST accepts integer I and integer POS values at the lower boundary 0 and upper valid boundary BIT_SIZE(I)-1.

requirements.title: BTEST reports whether bit POS of I is one
